Mercury in Retrograde

Pop Up Mob brought Huda Beauty's Mercury Retrograde palette to life in Covent Garden through a month-long, outer-space-inspired immersion, using citywide OOH, custom sound technology, and a fully sensory environment to turn the launch into a transportive world built around the five senses.
